Plugin.Name: unraid-unzip
Plugin.Overview: Adds Extract actions to the unRAID File Manager. Extracts 7z, zip, RAR, tar and the compressed tarballs (tar.gz/tgz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar.zst) to a destination you choose, with saved passwords, exclude patterns, an overwrite policy and background jobs. Backend is 7-Zip (downloaded and checksum-verified at install).
